title: Table-aware chunking with tenant-safe retrieval
checks: Paragraphs and table rows become separate chunks
[c['n'] for c in chunk(DOCS[0])] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] and len(chunk(DOCS[1])) == 2
Every table row carries the header
all(c['text'].startswith('| Tier | Nightly per diem (USD) |') for c in chunk(DOCS[0]) if 'Tier ' in c['text'])
A row chunk keeps its own values
any('Tier 2 | 70' in c['text'] for c in chunk(DOCS[0]))
Search finds the right row for its tenant
[(c['doc_id'], c['n']) for c in search(_chunks(), 'tier 2 nightly per diem', 'harbor')] == [('TRV-1', 4)]
all(c['tenant'] == 'harbor' for c in search(_chunks(), 'tier 2 nightly per diem', 'harbor', k=10))
The other tenant gets its own rate
Citations name the document and chunk
